name: chief-of-staff-guard
description: Blocks state-mutating shell and file-write actions from chief-of-staff harness sessions outside its own tracking-repo home.

interface.shortDescription: Keep chief-of-staff sessions to orchestration, not implementation.
interface.longDescription: A PreToolUse hook that blocks state-mutating shell commands and file writes from chief-of-staff harness sessions everywhere except its own tracking-repo home, forcing implementation work to be dispatched to another agent instead of performed directly.
defaultPrompt: Dispatch implementation work to another agent instead of doing it directly.
